construct: button.root:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255); outline-offset: 1px } — the focus ring as an OUTLINE state delta on the ROOT (antd Button, Switch)
why: antd draws every keyboard focus ring with `outline`, not box-shadow. The rest plane paints nothing (outline-width 0), so the ONLY observation is a focus-visible delta on a channel that is not in CHANNEL_TO_COMPUTED — if the state round drops it the component has no focus ring anywhere and nothing says so (P2 exam S1, root half; the nested-part half is antd-focus-outline-ring-child-part).

canvas.note: the focus-visible state preview draws an OUTSIDE-aligned stroke (outline-color + outline-width carried as a pair); outline-offset is annotated — Figma strokes have no offset
